result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.reverse()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Reverse the direction of all edges in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L11653-L11731){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.reverse() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Creates a new graph with the same nodes but all edge directions reversed (`u->v` becomes `v->u`). For undirected graphs, returns a new copy (no structural change). Preserves all node and edge attributes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new Graph with reversed edge directions. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Reverse a directed graph: ::: {#210a6049 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec original = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") ) reversed_graph = original.reverse() # Original: A->B->C # Reversed: C->B->A # Returns True original.has_edge("A", "B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` True ``` ::: ::: ::: {#cc4474e3 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns True reversed_graph.has_edge("B", "A") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` True ``` ::: ::: Analyze reverse dependencies: ::: {#18422697 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Dependencies: B depends on A, C depends on B deps = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B", label="provides") .add_edge("B", "C", label="provides") ) # Reverse to find what depends on each package dependents = deps.reverse() # Now: B->A (B dependent on A), C->B (C dependent on B) ``` ::: Use for transpose graph algorithms: ::: {#7a701383 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} g = ec.Graph(directed=True) g.add_node(label="X") g.add_node(label="Y") g.add_node(label="Z") g.add_edge("X", "Y") g.add_edge("Y", "Z") # Find strongly connected components # (some algorithms use both G and G^T) g_transpose = g.reverse() ``` :::
